notes.title: Game Update & Crowdfunding Campaign
notes.content:
Hello gamers!

Gabby here with a quick update on what we've been up to in Dreambound!

First of all, thank you for playing the Dreambound demo and I hope you've enjoyed it.

We're currently working our hardest updating the game further and completing it to the same polish as the demo.

Lets jump straight into the update!

[h2]Game Update[/h2]

Right now, our focus is on planning out the routes and, of course, art! Art takes the most time in visual novel development usually, and that's definitely the case for Dreambound.

Each artwork takes a long time to get to the quality level that we've shown so far. I think it's totally worth it!

We've also decided on general themes for each route, which has really helped us to further develop the stories we want to present with each character.

It goes something like this:

Crow - Dreams

Ivan - Bordering each

Kaine - Reality

Which will make more sense when you play - each route will spend more time in its respective theme. Crow's route will be the most dream-filled, while Ivan will spend time in both dreams and reality. Lastly, Kaine's route is anchored in reality.

Each story will feel very different and go to different places because of this. We also expect you will need to play all three to experience the full story.

The suggested play order is as follows: Crow -> Ivan -> Kaine.


[h2]Fundraising Campaign[/h2]
We're currently running a Kickstarter for Dreambound, too!

We have 13 days left on the campaign and we're currently 94% funded. We're so close! If it's within your means, even $5 goes a long way into continuing our game development journey.

We have a lot of physical merch, goodies, and even a chance to create your own character that will feature in the game available!

Here's a little teaser with some of the items:

notes.title: Dreambound Kickstarter Live NOW!
notes.content:
[h1]✨ Dreambound, a mystery BL visual novel, is now LIVE on Kickstarter! ✨[/h1]

Will Noah be able to move forward and solve the mystery⁠—or will he give in to the demons of his past?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42653060/289611c0d9e2cbc7af03bd20b9bd08ecafcbd265.png[/img]

We hope you're enjoying the demo for Dreambound!

Dreambound is a project we've been working on in secret for quite some time now, and we're so excited to finally release it to the world!

But we need your help!

To make Dreambound into reality, we need help funding it! Dreambound is our most expensive project to date, after all.

If you're able to, every dollar counts towards being able to make this fantastic game.
